nodes.name: Get Accounts
nodes.notes: Match rules + OneDrive folders from private-config.json, served by the pdf-decrypt sidecar (passwords are stripped).

nodes.name: Decrypt PDF
nodes.notes: Sidecar looks up the account's password itself. PDFs that aren't encrypted come back unchanged.

nodes.name: Upload to OneDrive
nodes.notes: PUT by path creates missing folders. Same email → same filename → replaced, so re-runs are idempotent.
